source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Jazz French Door Refrigerator (W10322959B, 19–22 cu ft)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Continue in Service Test Mode
steps.body: Service Test Mode (S-E) entered. Use Freezer UP/DOWN to select the test number for this procedure.
steps.sourceExcerpt: You are now in the SERVICES TEST operational mode and may use the diagnostic tests.

steps.title: Select Service Test 8
steps.body: In Service Test Mode (S-E), use Freezer UP/DOWN keys until freezer display shows 8. Refrigerator display blank until test is activated.

steps.title: Adjust FZ performance offset
steps.body: Service Test 8 adjusts freezer performance ±1° per step. WARMER ← (1 2 3 4 (5) 6 7 8 9) → COLDER using Refrigerator UP/DOWN. Default is 5. Last value saves when refrigerator door closes.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Adjustments of Service Test 8 will alter the performance of the unit.

steps.title: FZ offset documented
steps.oemOutcome: Record FZ performance offset if adjusted. Re-check freezer temps after 24 hr.
